brief.summary_1line: Rama explains to Bharata why he must keep the exile and urges Bharata to accept the throne to uphold their father's promise.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama in forest attire speaks calmly to the kneeling Bharata before gathered warriors in the woodland hermitage.
Rama, with Sita and Lakshmana beside him, gestures toward Bharata while explaining their father's vow under the forest trees.
